description: This circular walk explores the area surrounding the Berkshire village of Warfield. The walk begins from the Frost Folly Car Park which you can find on Weller's Lane, at postcode RG42 6EN. From here you follow a series of country lanes and public footpaths to Maiden's Green, Hawthorn Hill, Tickleback Row and Moss End. Along the way there's some lovely views of the surrounding countryside and bluebell woodland to enjoy. There's also the photogenic ford near Westley Mill and Hayley Green Farm, one of the oldest buildings in Warfield and originally the old moated manor house. You can continue your walking in the area by picking up the Bracknell Forest Ramblers Route. N.B Please note from July 2025, a section of this route is temporarily closed where it crosses the bridge on Malt Hill Road. However, a diversion is available by heading north and then using Church Lane to rejoin the path.
